api_secret_key.description: API key created in the Amplify dashboard.

access_token.description: Bearer token used for subsequent API requests.

fax_number.description: Destination fax number in E.164 format.

caller_id.description: Caller ID or sending fax number in E.164 format. When omitted, the value comes from the selected Fax Default or the account's default Fax Default.

template_id.description: ID of a Fax Default used as the cover-page template. Find it under Settings > iFax Settings > Fax Defaults. Cannot be combined with smart_document_id.

is_required_approval.description: Whether the fax requires approval before it is sent.

smart_document_id.description: ID of a Smart Template. Find it under Settings > iFax Settings > Smart Templates. Cannot be combined with template_id.

message.example: Fax sent through the Amplify API

scheduled_date.description: Scheduled transmission date and time in ISO 8601 format.

fax_quality.description: Requested fax quality. When omitted, the value comes from the selected Fax Default or the account's default Fax Default.

fax_data.description: Documents to include in the fax.

file_data.description: Base64-encoded contents of a PDF file.

file_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of a PDF file.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for the submitted fax job.
ID of the existing fax job whose documents will be forwarded.

fax_number.description: Destination fax number in E.164 format.

caller_id.description: Caller ID in E.164 format. When omitted, the account's default fax_as value is used.

job_id.description: ID of the new fax job created by the forward operation.
